conclusion: Both engines performed poorly on the two public code-switching samples. Qwen is optional and experimental; Persian FastConformer remains the default. This limited test does not establish general accuracy. GPU allocation is not proof that every INT8 operator executes on CUDA.
followupExperiments: A Persian language hint and general Persian/English vocabulary cues improved some Persian output but did not resolve mixed-speech errors. The cues could corrupt English-only speech, so mixed mode retains automatic identification without hotwords.
